description: Grouped non-major bumps share one pnpm-lock.yaml.
PR #919 showed Renovate can collapse a 0.x root importer and a 1.x fumadocs entry into a single 1.x resolution that breaks `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` on CI.
Run the same frozen install CI uses after the lockfile is regenerated so a bad graph fails the bot update instead of every required context.

Major version dependency updates are never auto-merged: the new line may drop APIs the harness, electron, or iOS code still calls, change required peer dependencies, or shift platform/runtime minimums.
The PR body below lists the verification recipe the reviewer must run before merge; the Renovate dashboard entry is the linked task.
packageRules.prBodyTemplate:
## Major dependency update: `{{depName}}` {{currentVersion}} -> {{newVersion}}

This is a major version bump of `{{depName}}`.

### Why this requires manual review

Major versions may include breaking API changes, dropped APIs the codebase still calls, new peer-dependency requirements, or shifted runtime minimums. Renovate does not auto-merge major bumps (see `renovate.json`).

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `pnpm install` resolves cleanly with no new peer-dependency warnings
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] Release notes reviewed; any breaking change in code paths this repo exercises is either patched here or called out in the PR description
- [ ] For Electron/iOS-native bumps: `pnpm package:mac:local` (or the matching iOS path) still builds

### Verification recipe

Run the commands above in an isolated checkout, then arm auto-merge once CI is green. Document any deviations from the new package's release notes in the PR comments.

description: Fleet compatibility guard (OPS-1063, owner 2026-11-10): a repo on typescript 5.x or older stays there.
Renovate keeps proposing typescript 7 to repos whose toolchains cannot take it; repos already on 7 (like BotFleet) are exempt through matchCurrentVersion.
Copy the guard rules into any repo where the suggestion cannot land.
Fleet compatibility guard: a repo that has deliberately moved to the typescript 6 line stays on it until a human opens 7.
Fleet compatibility guard: a repo on node 18 through 25 never sees node 26+ suggestions.
Owner 2026-11-10: node 26 proposals keep landing where the deployed runtime or platform cannot take them.
Covers the dockerfile and nvm managers; repos already on 26 or newer are exempt.
Fleet compatibility guard: @types/node tracks the runtime major, so the same boundary applies to the typings.
@trycua/cua-driver is pinned in several places that must move together in one deliberate PR:

package.json (this SDK), scripts/prepare-cua.mjs (CUA_RELEASE: the macOS executable asset and its sha256), server/container-computer.ts (CUA_DRIVER_VERSION and the Linux wheel URLs and hashes for the Local VM image), and server/remote-computer.ts (REMOTE_CUA_VERSION and the same wheels for the VPS driver).
The Linux desktop binary in scripts/cua-linux-release.mjs is pinned separately and is not part of this bump.
A bare package.json bump broke the Mac packaging step in #919, so Renovate must never raise it on its own.
This rule stays last so it overrides the non-major grouping rule above.
@xmldom/xmldom must stay on the 0.8 line.

electron-builder's plist parsing (through the plist package) calls DOMParser.parseFromString without a mimeType, which xmldom 0.9 requires, so packaging fails with 'the provided mimeType "undefined" is not valid'.
#919 moved the pnpm override in package.json to 0.9.12 and broke the Mac build.
Lift this cap only in a PR that proves electron-builder packages on the newer line.
